sentences.text: In short: GEMMA AS is an established small company in "detaljhandel med ur, klokker og smykker" based in Bergen, loss-making in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.

GEMMA AS describes itself on its website as: "Gemma A/S driver i tillegg Aseco Gull & Sølv butikker på Thon Senter Åsane, Thon Senter Steinkjer, Alti Buskerud, Thon Senter Sartor, Kvadrat og Alti Brotorvet. Vi har også eget gullsmedverksted de".
GEMMA AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2001-07-10, registered in Bergen.
It has 42 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 35.25M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 122,005 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 0.3% and a strong equity ratio of 50% of total assets.

Revenue rose 3.7% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 33.98M to NOK 35.25M); it was NOK 34.59M in 2023. The annual result went from a profit in 2024 to a loss in 2025 (2023: NOK 1.33M, 2024: NOK 161,822, 2025: -NOK 147,521).
GEMMA AS is led by Tone Kristin Stokkeholm, who is both CEO and board chair.
It has a board of 3. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-07-03 (within the past year).
GEMMA AS has a verified website (https://www.dingullsmed.no/), 1 linked public profile and 7 registered workplaces.
